description: Presents and grades a question with one selectable answer.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Title
Geography
Prompt
What is the capital of France?
Form
  • Paris
  • London
  • Berlin
Feedback
  • Correct.
  • London is in the UK.
  • Berlin is in Germany.
Solution
Paris

attributes.name: answer
attributes.description: 1-based index of the correct answer in the original list order. Not reflected back to the DOM when set via JS property — read from attribute only.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name passed to the underlying choice list.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrangement of answer choices: horizontal or vertical.

attributes.name: random
attributes.description: When present, items are shuffled on connect and after each reset.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an external JSON, HTML, Markdown, AsciiDoc or reStructuredText question definition. Keeps the definition out of authored markup, but does not make downloaded answers confidential.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: 1-based index of the currently selected answer; empty means no selection.

methods.name: randomize(): void
methods.description: Randomizes the order of answer items.

dependencies.name: tp-question
dependencies.summary: Base description-list container for question components.

dependencies.name: tp-radio-list
dependencies.summary: Transforms a list into a group of radio buttons.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-single-choice-question>` element presents and grades a question with one selectable answer.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Read the prompt, choose one answer and submit it. |
| Using the component | Review Feedback to understand the result or open Solution for the explanation. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> | Move between radio answers in a single-choice question. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on Submit | Submit the selected answers. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
